commit_message: Refine managed AI benchmark ADRs and add runtime debugging
pr_title: GameEngine: define managed local AI, benchmark campaigns, and runtime debugging
pr_body:
## Summary

- refine ADR 0155 so the Windows first release characterizes Windows-native vs WSL2 without requiring native Linux or an end-user runtime benchmark step
- make managed benchmark acquisition support explicit multi-model `Download & Run` with exact representation/provenance/storage review
- strengthen ADR 0156 with host-only benchmark oracles, leakage prevention, parameterized/holdout fixtures, incremental future-model comparison, and production debug-surface reuse
- add ADR 0157 for deterministic AI runtime debugging: fixed-tick input sequences, pause/resume/step, typed observation, host waits/assertions, replay reproduction, and capability-gated visual inspection
- register ADRs 0155-0157 in the ADR decision map and chronological registry

## Validation

Documentation-only change; GameEngine Windows Validation should select `docs` mode.
